mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: List SAP sessions that an ended server process left open.

description: [read-only] Lists the SAP sessions of this server's destination an ended server process left open (it was killed before logging them off): handle, role (built or debugger), destination, user, when recorded. Read from the session records alone. Only sessions of ended processes are listed. A server starting while exactly one built session of its destination is left is born on it; with several, all stay listed and untaken. Runs outside batch mode.
name: HandlerLeftoverSessionList
